gui.hoghunter.title: HOG HUNTER
message.hoghunter.no_ammo: Not enough iron bolts for this shot.
message.hoghunter.treatment_unavailable: Treatment needs an injury. Stop sprinting; stand still for a splint. Bandages need 4 hearts.
message.hoghunter.lantern_empty: Lantern is empty. Hold use with an oil can to refuel.
message.hoghunter.lantern_on: Lantern lit. Keep it in either hand for light.
message.hoghunter.depth_gate_locked: Gate locked. Extract evidence at a surface root altar to reach tier %s.
message.hoghunter.depth_gate_occupied: The gate cannot close while someone is inside it.
message.hoghunter.altar_overworld: The root altar only works in the Overworld.
message.hoghunter.altar_location: Camp: Y 48 or higher, open to the sky. Ritual: Y -49 or lower.
message.hoghunter.altar_need_tissue: Tier 1: bring 3 corrupted tissue to this surface altar.
message.hoghunter.altar_need_samples: Tier 2: bring 1 hook tooth and 1 spore sac to this surface altar.
message.hoghunter.altar_need_plate: Tier 3: bring 1 iron plate, and have treated a fracture with a splint or medkit.
message.hoghunter.altar_need_heart: The final extraction needs a root heart. Awaken Rootmother below Y -48.
message.hoghunter.altar_complete: Hunt complete. The root heart is yours to keep.
message.hoghunter.altar_extracted: Evidence extracted. Tier %s unlocked; your nerves settle.
message.hoghunter.altar_peaceful: Rootmother cannot awaken on Peaceful difficulty.
message.hoghunter.altar_need_tier: Extract evidence at a surface altar to reach tier 3 before the ritual.
message.hoghunter.altar_need_tusks: The ritual requires 3 marked tusks in your inventory.
message.hoghunter.altar_no_space: Clear a 3x3 floor with 3 blocks of headroom, centered 4 blocks north, south, east or west of this altar.
message.hoghunter.altar_awakened: Rootmother awakens. Return her heart to a surface altar.
tooltip.hoghunter.bolt_gun: Use: fire. Sneak + hold 0.5s: steady shot, +25% damage.
tooltip.hoghunter.silver_bolt_gun: Hold 1.5s: pin a hog for 2s; costs 2 iron bolts.
tooltip.hoghunter.mine_harpoon: Use: pull a hog, or grapple a chain / iron-block anchor.
tooltip.hoghunter.baited_snare: Place on solid ground. Arms in 1s; roots hogs for 5s.
tooltip.hoghunter.field_lantern: Use: toggle light. Hold in either hand; consumes oil.
tooltip.hoghunter.salt_shaker: Use on ground: 3 salt tiles. Repels lesser hogs for 12s.
tooltip.hoghunter.oil_can: Hold use 1.6s: add 50 oil, up to 100.
tooltip.hoghunter.treatment.bandage: Hold 3s: remove 1 wound. Requires at least 4 hearts.
tooltip.hoghunter.treatment.splint: Stand still and hold 5s: treat 1 fracture.
tooltip.hoghunter.treatment.medkit: Hold 4s: heal 2 hearts; treat 1 wound and 1 fracture.
tooltip.hoghunter.treatment.ration: Hold 1.6s: restore food and lower heart rate by 5 BPM.
tooltip.hoghunter.salt: Smelt a dried kelp block. Used for salt tools and rations.
tooltip.hoghunter.purified_tusk: Craft a hook tooth with salt and amethyst for silver guns.
tooltip.hoghunter.corrupted_tissue: Hog remains. Extract 3 at a surface root altar for tier 1.
tooltip.hoghunter.hook_tooth: From Chainjaws. Extract with a spore sac for tier 2.
tooltip.hoghunter.spore_sac: From Lanternbacks. Extract with a hook tooth for tier 2.
tooltip.hoghunter.iron_plate: From Ironbacks. Extract after treating a fracture for tier 3.
tooltip.hoghunter.marked_tusk: From deep hogs. Offer 3 to a deep root altar for Rootmother.
tooltip.hoghunter.root_heart: Rootmother trophy. Extract at a surface altar to finish the hunt.
tooltip.hoghunter.root_altar.surface: Camp: place at Y 48+ with open sky; use to extract evidence.
tooltip.hoghunter.root_altar.depths: Ritual: Y -49 or lower; tier 3 and 3 marked tusks required.
tooltip.hoghunter.depth_gate: Use: open after extraction. Deeper gates require higher tiers.
